text: ITEM 1 | Two halved cylindrical pieces, bright yellow outer skin with a pale cream-white center; cut faces show a loose, fibrous, tightly packed interior with irregular pale granular texture, slightly moist-looking, no visible browning or char, sitting side by side in the center of a white square plate; each piece about 4.5 cm across and 3.5 cm tall, together covering roughly 15% of the plate surface | 110
